description: Fix composer row_y calculation in components/kit/composer.coax and add sidebar hover/action row support in components/app/nav.coax.

steps.send: Fix two UI component issues: 1) In `components/kit/composer.coax`, fix the `row_y` positioning bug for the composer footer/action row. 2) In `components/app/nav.coax`, add hover state / action row support for sidebar navigation items. Verify both compile and pass tests with `coax/bin/coax test components/kit/composer.coax && coax/bin/coax test components/app/nav.coax`.

graders.run: grep -q app_side_action components/app/nav.coax && coax/bin/coax test components/kit/composer.coax && coax/bin/coax test components/app/nav.coax
